## Errors

The public errors of the family, by code: what a call may fail with.

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| `canceled` | The request was canceled. |
| `conflict` | The operation conflicts with the current version or work state. |
| `deadline_exceeded` | The request deadline expired. |
| `internal` | An internal server error occurred. |
| `invalid_argument` | The operation violates an application input constraint. |
| `invalid_params` | Operation parameters are invalid. |
| `invalid_request` | The request envelope is invalid. |
| `method_not_found` | The Workbench operation is unknown. |
| `not_found` | The requested project or work item does not exist. |
| `unauthenticated` | An authenticated Workbench user is required. |
